submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One high resolution native RGBA transparent full-body game sprite >=1024 square. Image 1 exact target: preserve ALL head, torso, costume, shoulders, arms, sleeve-elbow-hand chains and props EXACTLY. Sword anatomical RIGHT hand, rectangular blue talisman LEFT. Only redraw the two legs below skirt as instructed. Keep full canvas and original scale/position, no whole-body movement. Both feet point EAST screen RIGHT, straight sagittal axes, no outward splay. Character brown bun, blue-white-gold robe and white blue-trim boots remain identical. Full transparency, no floor or shadow, no annotations, no duplication/mirroring/interpolation/warping. Image 2 grounds leg proportions only; image 3 approved style finish.
The rear SCREEN-LEFT anatomical RIGHT leg must continue supporting. Unfold its backward-curled shin down and back so rear boot forefoot presses on ground near 95% canvas height, around 36% canvas width, heel raised modestly higher than image 2. The front SCREEN-RIGHT far LEFT boot should remain hovering, toe points east, do not let it touch floor yet. Front knee extended a little farther than preceding pose. This is last rear-right support pose before next frame left landing. Exactly one rear forefoot grounded.
